Your query seems to pull from a few different concepts depending on the exact context. 
1. French Green Energy Business
If you are looking for a business name, Solus'ion is a phonetic play on the French word solution. Most notably, Solus'ion Énergies Provence is a renewable and thermal energy company based in Manosque, France. In this context, pairing it with "ad infinitum" implies sustainable, infinite green energy. 
2. Latin Translation & Philosophy
If interpreted purely as a Latin phrase, "Solus ion ad infinitum" is a slight misspelling or hybrid phrase. Broken down: 
  • Solus: "Alone" or "only".
  • Ion: A Greek-derived scientific term for an atom/molecule with a net charge. (If meant as the Latin eon/aeon, it means "age" or "eternity").
  • Ad infinitum: A well-known Latin phrase meaning "to infinity" or "endlessly". 
A famous closely matching Latin maxim is "Nunquam minus solus quam cum solus" ("Never less alone than when alone"). 
3. Video Games & Music
The term Ad Infinitum is prominent across multiple media platforms: 
  • The Video Game: Ad Infinitum is a psychological horror game released in 2023. It follows a German soldier suffering from the psychological horrors of World War I. 
  • The Symphonic Metal Band: Ad Infinitum is a Swiss/German symphonic metal band fronted by Melissa Bonny, which originally began as her solo project (solus). 
  • Album Tracks: Independent music tracks like Anhedonia Ad Infinitum by Solus Stella or tracks on the Homestuck-related fan-album Skaia Ad Infinitum (which features a song titled Solus Vates) also tie these words together.
